title: Anatomy of a Whisker's Soul - Sissirat
description: Anatomy of a Whisker's Soul - Sissirat — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Commander

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Kill Sissirat's Vengeful Soul in Sissirat's Revenge off of The Whisker's Library - Edict Section in Level 4 to collect Sissirat's Soul in a Baubel then return to the Townston Commander.

Quest Reward: Gold and 2 King's Coins

Return to: Townston Commander

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Anatomy of a Whisker's Soul - Vergrim

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Kill Sissirat's Vengeful Soul in Sissirat's Revenge off of The Whisker's Library - Edict Section in Level 4 to collect Sissirat's Soul in a Baubel then return to the Townston Commander.

Offer:

Next is getting Sissirat's Soul crystal so prepare for smackdown! Sorry, I got a little excited. Good job on getting Rattle Tooth's Soul and we are now one step closer to unlocking Ratsputin's control over these infamous Whiskers. Enough of the pats on the back though, it is time to get back to work.

Run to Sissirat's Revenge located in The Whisker's Library - Edict Section off of Level 4 of Ratsputin's Gulag. Once you are there destroy Sissirat's Ghost and then Sissirat's Vengeful Soul. Once destroyed Sissirat's Vengeful Soul should drop Sissirat's Soul in a Baubel. Collect Sissirat's Soul in a Baubel then return to me, the Townston Commander, here in Townston.

Turn-in:

You have the soul? Alright, perhaps you are ready for the next quest. I bet you will never guess what it is!

Objectives:

  • Sissirat's Soul in a Baubel ×1

Level range: 81–100
